	mod1440_figures_handle = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "mod1440_figures_handle"
		parent_window_token = politics_tab

		visible = {
			always = yes
		}

		effects = {
			nf_toggle_click = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_nf_open = 1 } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_nf_open = 0 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { mod1440_nf_open = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_nf_open = 1 } }
					mod1440_nf_bars = yes
					mod1440_nf_fill = yes
					mod1440_h_draw = yes
				}
			}
		}

		ai_enabled = {
			always = no
		}
	}
